dedupe_keys.name: reporte de transbordadores y embarcaciones de ruta 2026

description: Reporte de transbordadores y embarcaciones de ruta (2026) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Mazatlán, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA MAZATLÁN). Información sobre el movimiento de transbordadores y embarcaciones de ruta, incluyendo número de arribos, volumen de carga en toneladas y cantidad de pasajeros transportados. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Administración del Sistema Portuario Nacional Mazatlán, S.A de C.V (ASIPONA MAZATLÁN). Its tags are actividad marítima, movilidad, movimiento portuario, puerto, sistema portuario. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
